Metadata.description: Run your coaching institute in one place: students, batches, attendance, fees and parent updates on WhatsApp.

Hero.headline: Run your coaching institute from one place
Hero.subhead: Students, batches, attendance, fees and tests in one dashboard — and parents get every update on WhatsApp.
Hero.note: No card needed. Set up in minutes.

Preview.label: Product preview
Preview.message: Aarav was marked present at 8:02 AM. Physics test on Friday.

Features.title: Everything your institute runs on
Features.subtitle: One place for the office, the teachers and the parents — so nothing lives in registers and spreadsheets.

whatsapp.title: Parents updated on WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: Attendance, fee reminders, test results and notices reach parents on the app they already use. Parents can ask questions and get answers straight away.

attendance.title: Attendance in seconds
attendance.body: Mark a whole batch in a few taps and let absent students' parents know automatically.

fees.title: Fees and receipts
fees.body: Instalments, discounts, receipts and reminders, with a clear list of who owes what.

academics.title: Tests and homework
academics.body: Enter marks, share results and track homework for every batch.

insights.title: AI insights
insights.body: Spot students at risk of dropping out early, and send parents a written progress report.

office.title: Staff and expenses
office.body: Teacher salaries, expenses and reports, so you always know where the money goes.

Steps.title: Up and running in an afternoon

one.title: Register your institute
one.body: Create your account and your free trial starts straight away.

two.title: Add batches and students
two.body: Type them in or import your existing spreadsheet.

three.title: Parents stay in the loop
three.body: Mark attendance, collect fees and share results — parents are updated on WhatsApp.
